words.display: SELECT * FROM dbo.Users ORDER BY Id OFFSET 20 ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY;
words.input: SELECT * FROM dbo.Users ORDER BY Id OFFSET 20 ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY;
words.annotation: ORDER BY / OFFSET FETCH：ページング（一意に並ぶ順序を指定。LIMITは使わない）

words.display: SELECT * FROM dbo.Users WHERE Active = 1 AND Age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 AND Id IN (1, 2, 3);
words.input: SELECT * FROM dbo.Users WHERE Active = 1 AND Age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 AND Id IN (1,2,3);
words.annotation: AND / OR / IN / BETWEEN：条件の組合せ（BETWEENは両端を含む）

words.display: SELECT u.Name, o.Amount FROM dbo.Users u LEFT JOIN dbo.Orders o ON o.UserId = u.Id;
words.input: SELECT u.Name, o.Amount FROM dbo.Users u LEFT JOIN dbo.Orders o ON o.UserId = u.Id;
words.annotation: INNER JOIN / LEFT JOIN：表を結合（右側をWHEREで絞ると実質内部結合になる場合）

words.display:
SELECT *
FROM dbo.Users u
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM dbo.Orders o
  WHERE o.UserId = u.Id
);
words.input: SELECT * FROM dbo.Users u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Orders o WHERE o.UserId = u.Id);
words.annotation: EXISTS / NOT EXISTS：関連行の存在

words.input: SELECT Id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CreatedAt, Id) AS RowNo FROM dbo.Users;
words.annotation: ROW_NUMBER / OVER：行番号（一意に順序を決める）

words.input: SELECT Id, UserId, Amount, SUM(Amount) OVER (PARTITION BY UserId) AS Total FROM dbo.Orders;
words.annotation: PARTITION BY / SUM OVER：行を残して集計

words.input: SELECT Id, LAG(Amount) OVER (PARTITION BY UserId ORDER BY Id) AS Previous FROM dbo.Orders;

words.display: ALTER TABLE dbo.Users ADD CONSTRAINT CK_Users_Age CHECK (Age >= 0);
words.input: ALTER TABLE dbo.Users ADD CONSTRAINT CK_Users_Age CHECK (Age >= 0);
words.annotation: CHECK / FOREIGN KEY / UNIQUE：データ制約（CHECKでNULLも拒否したい場合はNOT NULLを併用）

words.display: CREATE INDEX IX_Orders_UserId ON dbo.Orders(UserId) INCLUDE (Amount);
words.input: CREATE INDEX IX_Orders_UserId ON dbo.Orders(UserId) INCLUDE (Amount);
words.annotation: CREATE INDEX：索引作成（読み取りと更新・容量コストを比較）

words.display: CREATE VIEW dbo.ActiveUsers AS SELECT Id, Name FROM dbo.Users WHERE Active = 1;
words.input: CREATE VIEW dbo.ActiveUsers AS SELECT Id, Name FROM dbo.Users WHERE Active = 1;
words.annotation: CREATE VIEW：ビュー定義（CREATE VIEWはバッチ先頭等の制約。通常は結果を保存しない）
datetime2 / datetimeoffset / uniqueidentifier：日時・UUID（datetime2はタイムゾーンを保持しない）

words.display: SELECT CONCAT(Name, N'さん'), LEN(Name), SUBSTRING(Name, 1, 2) FROM dbo.Users;
words.input: SELECT CONCAT(Name,N'さん'), LEN(Name), SUBSTRING(Name,1,2) FROM dbo.Users;
words.annotation: CONCAT / LEN / SUBSTRING：文字列処理（LENは末尾の空白を数えない）
DATEADD / DATEDIFF：日時の加減・境界数（DATEDIFFは単純な経過時間でなく単位境界数）

words.input: DECLARE @i int=0; WHILE @i<3 BEGIN IF @i=1 PRINT N'one'; SET @i+=1; END;
words.annotation: IF / WHILE / BEGIN END：手続き的制御

words.display: EXEC sys.sp_executesql N'SELECT * FROM dbo.Users WHERE Id=@id', N'@id int', @id = 1;
words.input: EXEC sys.sp_executesql N'SELECT * FROM dbo.Users WHERE Id=@id', N'@id int', @id=1;
words.annotation: sp_executesql：値をパラメーター化した動的SQL（未検証入力をSQL文字列へ連結しない）
